proxies: 20 prior daily highs/lows, not approved structure

plans.full: sell A at next open; buy B with modeled available cash
plans.staged25: 25% initial A shares per new B price/volume evidence, up to 4 steps
plans.staged50: 50% initial A shares per new B price/volume evidence, up to 2 steps
plans.cash: sell A at next open; no reinvestment/interest
plans.delay5: retain A five additional sessions; full switch on session 6

staging_event: prior close > frozen B proxy AND prior close > previous close AND prior volume > previous volume
sensitivity: 10/30 bps slippage and settled-cash T+2 variant at 20 sessions
